body.message:
Hi, I hope you are doing well 🌹

Since we are moving out, I wanted to check if you are open to tenant referrals on an ongoing basis.

From time to time, I may know people who are looking to rent apartments in Dubai, and I can introduce suitable tenants to you for this apartment or other available properties.

Please let me know if you offer any referral fee or commission if a tenant I introduce successfully signs a rental agreement.

Thank you.
